relationships.KB_LINKS_TO: KBDocsQADocument -> KBDocsQADocument; properties: anchor_text, source_section, target_anchor, context

extraction.images: Alt text, OCR, and normalized descriptions remain occurrence- and asset-scoped text evidence; image vectors are excluded.
extraction.semantics: kg-gen 0.4.0 open extraction followed by entity and predicate clustering.
extraction.provenance: Every claim must resolve to one retrieval unit and carry its source excerpt.
extraction.schema_policy: KGGen predicates are stored as data nodes, not dynamically-created Neo4j relationship types.
extraction.identity_scope: Image assets, code identifiers, KGGen entities, predicates, and claims are project-scoped to prevent false cross-project paths.

retrieval_policy.foundation: BM25 plus text HNSW; image alt/OCR/description text participates in this foundation
retrieval_policy.hub_policy: Route, reusable, code, and KGGen entities are degree bounded.
retrieval_policy.evidence_policy: A graph path is a discovery signal; its supported retrieval unit is the evidence.
